        print(r, 'empty')
        continue
    # group consecutive
    groups=[]
    cur=[cols[0]]
    for c in cols[1:]:
        if c==cur[-1]+1:
            cur.append(c)
        else:
            groups.append(cur); cur=[c]
    groups.append(cur)
    print(r, groups)
